dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kinds of tea are there?

dialogues.speaker: Quezhi
dialogues.text: Our teahouse proudly offers both the Single-Origin Yauwan Tea and Sunglo Tea that Chenyu Vale is renowned for, in every available grade!

dialogues.speaker: Quezhi
dialogues.text: We also have the Tianheng Bohea, Yunlai White Tea, and Bishui Green Tea, which are popular in Liyue Harbor, all at export quality!
